plan.summary: Follow-up to bro-5647-g. (1) John Proctor Is the Villain: recoupedSource and designationBasis, which bro-5647-g could not set (the old source was hidden on the public page, and the apply gate filled a silence basis when the label changed). (2) Eight shows whose capitalization is their SEC Form D offering maximum while the same cited filing states the amount actually capitalized (the The Cottage pattern from Dots' Oct 19 audit): A Doll's House, KPOP, Left on Tenth, Mr. Saturday Night, The Anarchist, The Bridges of Madison County, The Great Society, The Hills of California. Old values read from the private core data at f0cfd62.
steps: Eight capitalizations moved from the offering maximum to the filing's capitalized amount, with the filing quoted
